name: Make_Stationary: Frugal ELM-based deseasonalization for renewable-energy time series
description: A frugal deseasonalization operator based on phase-conditioned Extreme Learning Machines, used as a controlled instrument to test whether removing the deterministic diurnal and annual cycle of renewable-energy and meteorological time series improves downstream forecasting. Two variants, PROJECTION and PHASE, are benchmarked against FOURIER, LOESS and rolling-median deseasonalization, and against direct forecasting on the raw signal, over nine variables and horizons from 1 to 6 hours, on data from Corsica, France.
